title: AliExpress: 22% Cashback on Affiliated Products ($30 Cap Per Transaction) @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: AliExpress: 22% Cashback on Affiliated Products ($30 Cap Per Transaction) @ TopCashback AU

[freebiemaster1902] What is everyone going to use during the aliexpress promo? This or the UK site
[ASR-Briggs] You’d be mad not to set up a UK account. 22% capped vs 35% uncapped. Bit of a no brainier.
[Some Random Guy] are there any issues with using the uk one (ie any limitations or terms of use to watch out for?)
[Some Random Guy] I'm here to update that I had absolutely ZERO issues setting up a wise account, TCB UK, and connecting wise to TCB UK (remember to use referrals for everything). Further, aliexpress tracked very quickly. Total spent 608 AUD, cashback pending 108 GBP (+10 GBP for referral) ~33.7% cashback (as some products weren't referral, some had small delivery charges and there's the GST as well (but most of this was negated through coupons and PayPal discount).
[adrianhughes1998] What time today does this start?
And can you stack it with the Team Ozbargain cashback?
[Clear] Start times are under the social media buttons. Stacks with team OzBargain
[pichxlonco] Thanks! Gonna try my luck this time again with the Nothing buds 2 plus, sending them to an auspost parcel box (others mentioned this worked)
[Schniz2] Mine never arrived from the last deal :(
[pichxlonco] Almost none arrived. Some very few were lucky but almost all of them were supposedly destroyed. Don't claimed they used parcel locker and that they received them without issues
[pichxlonco] @Schniz2: Apparently the last deal were sent through Singapore post and all of the buds were packed together into a single package /pallet and then they were destroyed by Singapore post because they failed to declare that they had lithium batteries or something like that. Maybe a single order might go through, compared to 100+ like last deal
[NVidia Sucks] Not going to use AliExpress ever again after this. Bought an ALLPOWERS VOLIX P300 from their official store back in May, barely used it, and recently tried charging it with a 60W solar panel only to find it won't charge at all.
Tried to claim warranty, but ALLPOWERS' store on AliExpress has completely disappeared, and because it’s past 3 months, AE won't let me raise an after sales dispute. Emailed AE support and they basically told me I need to provide an official 3rd party quality inspection report (from SGS, TUV, etc.) within 24 hours to prove it's not user error.
Who in their right mind would pay hundreds for a 3rd party lab inspection for a $140 power station? Absolutely ridiculous customer service.
[NVidia Sucks] Here's the bullshit email I received today:Dear Customer,
Thank you for contacting AliExpress Customer Care. We are committed to providing you with the support you need for your order 8210584889257856.
We need a valid quality inspection report from a third-party company to confirm that the product quality issue was not caused by human error. Third-party inspection companies include: BV, TUV, SGS, CCIC. This is a type of document we will wait for your respond in 24 hours.
Thank you for your patience and understanding. If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Sincerely,
AliExpress Customer Care
[SeanConnery] Are you kidding me? You went ahead and bought a power station WITHOUT a 3rd party quality inspection report (from SGS, TUV, etc.)????
Everyone knows you always have to purchase a 3rd party quality inspection report (from SGS, TUV, etc.)
[Clear] I asked AliExpress and it doesn't specifically have to be from those companies. Can get reports other ways
[Russ] Bought an ALLPOWERS VOLIX P300 from their official store back in May,
The battery in that is a lithium-ion battery. Just like car batteries, lithium-ion batteries should not be left flat for any significant amount of time, as their chemicals degrade rapidly when they're left flat.
If it has been flat for the three months since you purchased it, that could explain why it won't charge now. Did you give it a full charge when you received it?

[OzWaster] Check your carts people. Aliexpress is dodgy with their pricing.
Today i put a list of items together in the app today, priced at x.
Used ShopBack to go to ali, noticed it was around 10% more expensive.
Use another device (without ShopBack), and the lower price turns up again.
Tried to go thorough ShopBack on the second device, price is up again.
Seems to be that the pricing goes up to cover the cash back.
Probably because it's so much higher.
[jv] Please ensure that the products you want to buy are affiliated by using the link checker.
HTTP Status 400 – Bad Request
[Clear] Have you tried turning it off and on again?
[jv] It seems to only work on Edge, not Chrome.
[Aussian] Do I need to clear the cart before clicking on the TopCashback link?
[carrawa] VPN: So your entire shopping experience needs to be completed without a VPN, not just clicking through?
[Clear] Turn off your VPN because you need to be in Australia and anything that can block tracking will stop the transaction from being recorded.
[Schrodinger] Hi @Clear, does TopCashback UK also allow stacking Store coupon codes?
Couldn't find any mention if that in the other post.
I have alot of coins left. So thinking of stacking PayPal discount, seller coupons and coins along with AliExpress general/sale codes.
[Clear] Yes. Just make sure products are affiliated.
[Quoc11] I have bad memories with topcashback. they didn't track my orders, 1 time in December, 2 times in Feb, and I had to file it manually. I'm still waiting.
did it via mobile app. on the other hand did shopback once via mobile and it tracked ( if only shopback gave higher returns)

because on my browser topcashback rarely ever tracks.
[Russ] Some browsers have built-in anti-tracking measures. Which browser are you using, and do you have an ad blocker, are you using a VPN etcetera.

[coldazure] Is there a limit on the number of transactions I can make during this promotion period, each transaction claiming a maximum of $30?
[leoorange3107] Bought 4 items in one transaction clicked though Topcashback app. Paid by paypal. 3 items tracked from Topcashback and 1 item went to Shopback. I didn't click shopback and cashback went there. Anybody has experience about this?
[poppingtags] Hey Clear, do you have any info on how cashback works with pre-order items? I'm assuming if it doesn't ship within the cashback period, you won't get the cashback?
[Clear] I don't know tbh. Never bought a preorder.
